candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall collect a minimum of three samples (flow-weighted composite if possible) from the outfall(s).
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether 'if possible' makes flow-weighted composite mandatory or discretionary changes which sampling protocol was applicable and whether collected samples satisfy the monitoring obligation.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall collect a second and third sample (composite samples if possible) for use during the 24-hour renewal of each dilution concentration for each test.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of the second/third sample requirement and the 'if possible' composite qualifier affects whether additional sampling beyond the minimum three was required for each toxicity test.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee must collect the composite samples so that the maximum holding time for any effluent sample shall not exceed 36 hours for first use of the sample. The permittee must have initiated the toxicity test within 36 hours after the collection of the last portion of the first composite sample.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Different readings of the 36-hour holding and initiation deadlines could change whether sampling and test initiation met applicable procedural monitoring requirements.

candidates.exact_span: A holding time up to 72 hrs is allowed upon notification to EPA and NMED of the need for additional holding time.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether notification was required and sufficient to extend holding time to 72 hours affects whether samples used after 36 hours still satisfied monitoring conditions.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee must collect the composite samples such that the effluent samples are representative of the discharge duration, and of any periodic episode of chlorination, biocide usage or other potentially toxic substance discharged on an intermittent basis.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether representativeness obligations were triggered by intermittent discharges changes applicable monitoring requirements (B) and whether available results adequately represent required episodes or leave evidence gaps (C).

candidates.exact_span: For any test which fails, is considered invalid, or which is terminated early for any reason, the full report must be submitted for agency review.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Classification of a test as failed, invalid, or early-terminated changes reporting obligations (B) and how missing or non-valid results should be treated versus required monitoring with inadequate evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: A valid test for each species must be reported during each reporting period specified in PART I of this permit unless the permittee is performing a TRE which may increase the frequency of testing and reporting.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Applicability depends on cross-referenced PART I reporting periods and whether a TRE was in progress; different interpretations change required test frequency (B) and whether absence of a valid reported result reflects conditional non-requirement or missing evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: One set of biomonitoring data for each species is to be recorded on the DMR for each reporting period.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether one DMR entry per species per reporting period was mandatory affects monitoring and reporting obligations (B) and whether a missing DMR line indicates unfulfilled requirement or another documented no-data state (C).

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall submit the results of each valid toxicity test on the subsequent monthly DMR for that reporting period as follows below.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of 'subsequent monthly DMR' and alignment with 'that reporting period' affects when reporting was required (B) and whether data absent from the expected DMR month should be treated as late, not required, or unresolved missing evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: Submit retest information clearly marked as such with the following month's DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether retest results were required on the following month's DMR changes applicable reporting obligations (B) and how retest-coded or delayed submissions should be classified when ordinary results are absent (C).

candidates.exact_span: Only results of valid tests are to be reported on the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Determining which tests count as 'valid' changes what must appear on the DMR (B) and whether a period without a DMR numeric result reflects invalid testing, conditional non-reporting, or inadequate evidence of required monitoring (C).
